title: top-up: CI cargo check scanner
definition: module added to worker/deno/lib/ after the recorded security-sweep slices: ci_cargo_checks.ts reads the target repository's workflow YAML as data (never executes it), derives the cargo clippy and test-compile commands CI runs, and refuses working directories that are absolute, contain .. or hold expressions (#4630); gate_infra_release.ts (PR #4896 review) counts release markers on a PR: it reads each PR comment's author login and body through a fixed jq filter (`.[] | {login: .user.login, body: .body} | @json`), parses each untrusted JSON line, and counts only comments by a trusted login (matched case-insensitively) whose body contains the marker for its key, a key validated against an allow-list before it is built into the marker
